evidence.title: shadcn/ui + TanStack Form - Type-Safe React Forms

name: shadcn/ui + TanStack Form
summary: shadcn/ui form components wired to TanStack Form for type-safe React forms with schema validation and accessible styling.
description: A component set that pairs the shadcn/ui Form components with TanStack Form, keeping Field-level type safety and adding schema validation through Zod V4 (the site also lists Valibot and ArkType). It ships type-safe field wrappers, TanStack's form state management, responsive and accessible form layouts, a migration guide to 1.0.0 and a component test suite. Add the shadcn/ui pieces it wraps (field, button, input, label, checkbox, textarea) with the shadcn CLI; distributed as a shadcn registry item from felipestanzani/shadcn-tanstack-form.
contains: type-safe fields with full TypeScript inference
schema validation with Zod V4; Valibot and ArkType listed on the site
add wrapped shadcn/ui pieces with the shadcn CLI: field, button, input, label, checkbox, textarea
component test suite; accessible, responsive form layouts
